title: Sidebar
body: Understand Use Implement Overview The Sidebar is an in-page navigation component for long-form pages. It stays visible while scrolling and automatically highlights the current section using Scroll Spy. It is reusable across pages as long as the navigation links and content sections share matching anchor IDs.
